modules.name: Outage preparation and mobilization
modules.desc: Pre-outage readiness: scope freeze, OEM parts and lease engines confirmed, contractor mobilization, laydown, tool cribs, outage trailers, and the safety and LOTO plan.

tasks.desc: Scope freeze, parts and lease-engine confirmation
Mobilize contractors, laydown and tool cribs

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Shutdown, cooldown and isolation
modules.desc: Take the units off line with the data center load carried by the remaining units, BESS or grid: shutdown, forced or natural cooldown, gas and electrical isolation, LOTO and permits.

tasks.desc: Transfer load and shut down units
Gas and electrical isolation, LOTO ({LOTO} points)

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Scaffolding, access and insulation removal
modules.desc: Scaffold to inspection and repair points, insulation and lagging removal and reinstatement, and the rental days that come with them.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Gas turbine combustion inspection
modules.desc: Combustion inspection on a frame gas turbine (about every 8,000 to 12,000 fired hours): remove and inspect fuel nozzles, liners, crossfire tubes and transition pieces, swap in refurbished hardware, borescope, and close up.

queries.prompt: Exchange hardware set (vs. reinstall after inspection)?

tasks.desc: Remove fuel nozzles, liners and transition pieces

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Gas turbine hot gas path inspection
modules.desc: Hot gas path inspection (about every 24,000 fired hours, typically 3 to 5 weeks): full combustion inspection scope plus removing the turbine casing upper half and inspecting or replacing stage 1-2 nozzles, buckets and shrouds.

queries.prompt: Replace stage 1-2 parts with an exchange set?

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Gas turbine major inspection
modules.desc: Major inspection (about every 48,000 fired hours): flange-to-flange disassembly, rotor out, compressor and turbine stages, bearings and seals, all hot gas path parts, controls and alignment.

queries.prompt: Send the rotor to a shop for repair?

tasks.desc: Hot gas path and casing disassembly
Inspect compressor, rotor, bearings and seals
Reinstall rotor, casing and hot gas path
Alignment, controls calibration and close up

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Aeroderivative engine swap
modules.desc: Aeroderivative units are kept running by swapping the gas generator or whole engine for a lease or spare engine and sending the removed engine to an OEM depot: disconnect, roll out, roll in, reconnect and test run.

tasks.desc: Roll in lease or spare engine

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Borescope, compressor wash and inlet filters
modules.desc: Routine work done in any outage window: borescope inspections, offline compressor water wash, inlet filter change-out, and lube oil sampling and filter changes.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Generator inspection
modules.desc: Generator minor or major inspection: electrical tests (insulation resistance, polarization index), stator wedge and end-winding inspection, rotor-in robotic or rotor-out inspection, exciter and bearings.

tasks.desc: Remove end shields and inspect (rotor in)

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Steam turbine inspection
modules.desc: Combined cycle steam turbine: valve inspections, borescope or casing-open inspection, bearings and seals, and lube oil system service.

tasks.desc: Stop, control and bypass valve inspections
Bearings, seals and lube oil service

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: HRSG inspection and tube repair
modules.desc: Heat recovery steam generator: open and ventilate, inspection and NDE of harps, headers and drums, tube leak repairs, flow-accelerated corrosion checks, and hydrotest.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Cooling tower or air-cooled condenser
modules.desc: Heat rejection: fan and gearbox inspections, ACC tube cleaning and leak checks, or cooling tower fill and drift eliminator repairs, plus circulating water pump service.

tasks.desc: ACC tube cleaning and leak check
Tower fill and drift eliminator repairs

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Reciprocating engine overhaul
modules.desc: Gas engine overhauls by running hours: top-end (cylinder heads, valves, spark plugs or prechambers) or major (liners, pistons, bearings, crankshaft checks), with turbocharger exchange and alignment checks.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Engine auxiliaries, radiators and exhaust
modules.desc: Radiator cleaning and fan service, charge air coolers, exhaust and silencer inspections, SCR / oxidation catalyst replacement and urea system service.

tasks.desc: Radiators, fans and charge air coolers

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Gas turbine SCR and CO catalyst
modules.desc: Catalyst work behind the turbines or in the HRSG: catalyst sampling, ammonia injection grid tuning prep, module change-out and seal repairs, then emissions verification.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Fuel cell stack replacement
modules.desc: Solid-oxide fuel cell blocks are serviced module by module while the rest of the block keeps running: stack exchange, filters and desulfurizer media, and module restart.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: BESS augmentation and inverter service
modules.desc: Battery storage: add augmentation modules to restore capacity, inverter / PCS preventive maintenance, HVAC and fire suppression checks, and a capacity test.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Step-up transformer maintenance
modules.desc: Generator step-up and auxiliary transformers: oil sampling and dissolved gas analysis, electrical tests, bushing and cooling system inspection, oil processing where needed.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Switchyard and breaker maintenance
modules.desc: HV and MV breakers, disconnects and instrument transformers: timing and contact resistance tests, mechanism service, insulator cleaning, and the MV switchgear feeding the data halls.

tasks.desc: HV breaker tests and mechanism service
MV breaker tests and racking checks

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Protective relay and microgrid controls testing
modules.desc: Generator, transformer, bus and feeder protection testing, trip checks, and the microgrid controller load-shed, islanding and transfer logic that protects the data center load.

tasks.desc: Microgrid controller load-shed and islanding tests

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Controls, instruments and CEMS
modules.desc: Instrument calibration, control system patches or upgrade, unit control panels, and CEMS analyzer service and calibration before restart.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Valves, pumps and motors
modules.desc: Fuel gas, steam and water valves pulled for overhaul or replaced, pump seal and bearing work, and motor tests.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Return to service
modules.desc: Bring units back: remove LOTO, fill and vent, first fire, combustion and emissions tuning, synchronize, load in steps, check vibration and protection, then a reliability run before the data center load is returned.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Close-out and demobilization
modules.desc: Housekeeping, final punch, as-found / as-left reports, OEM inspection reports, lessons learned and demobilization.
